name: Brothers In Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are united as brothers and sisters in Christ, transcending all earthly distinctions such as ethnicity, social status, and gender, because all who do God's will are part of His family. This spiritual brotherhood is grounded in the transformative power of receiving Christ, which grants the privilege to become children of God. The mutual encouragement and teaching among believers, likened to iron sharpening iron, reflect the deep relational bond that God honors by calling them brethren. Together, they are called to let Christ's word dwell richly within, fostering unity and growth in holiness.
